features.name: Cloud Migration Tooling
features.description: End-to-end cloud migration journey supporting data replication from on-premises Business Central to Business Central online using Azure Data Factory with self-hosted integration runtime.
caveats: Requires table definition alignment
Custom fields on standard tables are ignored unless extension refactoring is completed
Data corruption in code fields must be sanitized before migration

features.name: One-Step Upgrade to Version 21
features.description: Capability to upgrade directly from version 14 to version 21, skipping intermediate versions, with option to either go live on-premises or replicate to SaaS.
caveats: Requires on-premises upgrade scripts if not using cloud replication
Support duration dependent on technical feasibility

features.name: Direct Cloud Migration from Version 14
features.description: Path to skip on-premises upgrade and replicate directly to latest cloud version, with cloud handling the version upgrade instead.
caveats: More forgiving with breaking changes than on-premises upgrade
Still requires table definition alignment

features.name: Table Extension Auto-Refactoring
features.description: Prototype feature to automatically split custom fields from standard Microsoft tables into table extensions during cloud migration without requiring manual code.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have a prototype that we are currently testing so we believe that during the cloud migration we will be able to split the
caveats: Currently in prototype phase
Announcement pending in coming weeks
Not yet available for production use

features.name: Invoke-NavSanitizeField Commandlet
features.description: PowerShell commandlet to detect and sanitize corrupted code fields containing non-printing characters that would fail during cloud migration.
caveats: Does not cover company name fields which are text fields, not code fields
Should be run before production cloud migration
Can be run with Dash table ID parameter to optimize specific tables

features.name: Table Mapping for Cloud Migration
features.description: Feature allowing renaming and prefixing of tables during cloud migration, such as adding three-letter prefix or suffix to table names.
caveats: Required when source and target table names differ
Part of manual preparation before migration

features.name: Azure Data Factory Integration for Migration
features.description: Cloud-based data integration service used to copy, move and transform data from on-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL database, using pipelines, activities and integration runtimes.
caveats: Requires self-hosted integration runtime for on-premises data sources
Can use Azure integration runtime if source is already in Azure
Requires setup of connection strings and runtime configuration

features.name: Self-Hosted Integration Runtime
features.description: Compute infrastructure installed in customer's on-premises network that enables secure data copying from on-premises SQL Server to cloud, communicating only with Azure Data Factory.
caveats: Requires minimum .NET 4.72
Machine must remain online during migration
No NST running needed

features.name: Cloud Migration Wizard
features.description: Setup wizard in destination environment that collects SQL Server connection information and integration runtime details for configuring cloud migration.

features.name: Preparation Pipeline
features.description: Automatic pipeline created during setup that performs compatibility checks between source and destination, verifies versions match, and creates stored procedures on both sides.

features.name: Replication Pipeline
features.description: Pipeline created after preparation that knows about all tables, extensions, and is ready to execute the actual data copy operation.

features.name: User Permissions Validation
features.description: Checks for required permissions including super role in BC, delegated admin consent, SQL server CIS admin role, and database owner role for migration setup.
caveats: Delegated admin requires customer consent
SQL user needs CIS admin and DB owner roles

features.name: SQL Connection String Validation
features.description: Validates exact format of connection strings including keywords and parameters, with documentation and ability to copy from Azure portal.
caveats: Connection string must match exact format
Common errors from missing keywords

features.name: Database Query Performance Optimization
features.description: Recommendations include updating statistics and reorganizing indexes to improve performance and avoid timeout situations during migration.

features.name: Version Matching Validation
features.description: Ensures major version between source and destination matches, and application version property in tenant database is manually updated after upgrade.
caveats: Application version property must be manually updated after upgrade

features.name: SQL Connection Verification
features.description: Pre-migration checks including user connectivity to on-premises database, integration runtime machine access to SQL Server, firewall rules, and remote access configuration.
caveats: Firewall must allow client IP address
SQL Server must allow remote access

features.name: Migration Run Execution
features.description: Initiated from Cloud migration management page with Run migration now action, calls Azure Data Factory to start replication pipeline and instructs self-hosted integration runtime to copy data to Azure blob storage then to tenant database.
caveats: Regional blob storage ensures data does not move outside region

features.name: Data Compression and Two-Step Transfer
features.description: Self-hosted integration runtime compresses data for faster on-premises to cloud transfer, decompresses in Azure. Two-step process through blob storage improves overall performance.

features.name: Large Table Replication
features.description: Large tables are replicated individually through Azure blob storage path with visible progress tracking on Cloud migration management page statistics.

features.name: Small Table Optimization
features.description: Small tables are collected, serialized into JSON, compressed, chunked into records of special table and replicated as one table to improve efficiency. Progress reported only when records reach tenant database.
caveats: Progress not immediately visible
Must wait for records to reach tenant database

features.name: Full and Incremental Replication
features.description: First replication run is full replication of all tables. Subsequent runs use SQL change tracking to replicate only delta changes for faster incremental runs.
caveats: Do not replace or change on-premises database during replication or change tracking becomes invalid
Invalid change tracking requires full replication again

features.name: Integration Runtime Offline Handling
features.description: If integration runtime machine stays offline too long during migration, automated cleanup procedures may wipe Azure resources and prevent easy resumption requiring full setup again.
caveats: Machine must stay online during migration
Prolonged offline status triggers automated cleanup

features.name: Database Replacement Impact
features.description: Replacing or restoring on-premises database before replication completes causes SQL errors for invalid object names and stored procedures, requiring full setup restart.
caveats: Most difficult errors to resolve
Occurs when database replaced during replication

features.name: Metadata size limitations
features.description: Azure Data Factory has a 4 megabyte limitation on metadata, which is a JSON serialized description of all fields in all tables across extensions and companies being replicated.
caveats: Error messages from Azure are not easily understandable
Cannot intercept or modify Azure error warnings

features.name: Multi-company migration optimization
features.description: Reduce the number of companies migrated at once through the cloud migration management page to avoid metadata size errors. Optimal size is approximately 10 to 15 companies.
caveats: Actual optimal number depends on data volume and number of extensions

features.name: Extension cleanup for migration
features.description: Uninstall unnecessary extensions from the cloud tenant prior to cloud migration to reduce metadata size, then reinstall them as needed after migration.
caveats: Having extensions without data is not harmful but contributes to metadata size

features.name: Table-level replication exclusion
features.description: Exclude specific tables from cloud migration by setting the AL table attribute ReplicateData to false.

features.name: Tenant media bulk copy handling
features.description: Handle out of memory exceptions during bulk copy of tenant media table by using a stored procedure to redirect tenant media to one-to-one copying instead of bulk.
caveats: Workaround is a hack
Images are not compressible
Out of memory errors originate from Azure Data Factory infrastructure, not Business Central

features.name: Table-to-table full copy error handling
features.description: When row delimiter errors occur during table-to-table full copy, identify the failed table and redirect it into bulk copy if it is compressible.
caveats: Error messages are not easily understandable
Errors reported to Azure Data Factory for potential future fixes

features.name: On-premises infrastructure monitoring
features.description: Monitor CPU and memory utilization on the integration runtime machine and Azure SQL source database during cloud migration. Upscale the database if high consumption is observed.
caveats: Integration runtime has specified system requirements that must be honored

features.name: Database statistics and index optimization
features.description: Update statistics and reorganize indexes on the source database before setting up cloud migration to improve performance. Use a dedicated SQL Server not busy with other production activities.
caveats: Should be done once before setup
Dedicated server performs faster than shared production server

features.name: Default data mapping for table replication
features.description: Data is copied between on-premises and cloud tables when SQL names match based on company name, table name, and extension ID. Extra fields in on-premises tables are silently ignored.
caveats: Extra fields in on-premises are silently ignored with no warnings
No errors are raised for field mismatches

features.name: Missing table warning during replication
features.description: When a table exists in the cloud but not in the on-premises database, a warning is displayed that the table does not exist in the local installation.
caveats: Warning is usually safe to ignore but should be verified to ensure no tables were accidentally missed

features.name: Table mapping for different table names
features.description: Use the table mapping action in the cloud migration management page to map tables with different names between on-premises and cloud, such as when extensions use different naming prefixes.
caveats: Only fields with the same names in both tables are migrated

features.name: Improved upgrade logic for cloud migration
features.description: Leverage existing upgrade logic for previous versions during cloud migration. Adapt upgrade code to be reusable for cloud migration without needing duplicate changes across multiple upgrade versions.
caveats: Cannot invoke upgrade codeunits directly
Cannot access obsolete or removed fields from non-upgrade scope

features.name: Single-session upgrade with full app inclusion
features.description: Trigger the full upgrade code with all apps included in a single session to enable stable upgrades with automatic reporting, telemetry, and backup restore on failure.
caveats: Hot fixes are not applied during upgrade
Prevents accidental locks and errors from concurrent user access

features.name: Upgrade status tracking in Admin Center
features.description: Track upgrade progress through the Admin Center where the environment status flips to updating. Operations tab shows upgrade history and status. Environment is inaccessible during upgrade.
caveats: Users cannot access environment during upgrade
Approximately 3 minutes for upgrade to complete before status flips to active

features.name: Automatic point-in-time restore on upgrade failure
features.description: If upgrade fails, the system automatically restores the tenant to point-in-time before the upgrade was run. Full stack trace is provided for troubleshooting.
caveats: Error messages are being improved for better clarity
Tenant remains operational after restore

features.name: Legacy upgrade flow support
features.description: The old upgrade flow is still supported alongside the new improved upgrade process. Can be triggered programmatically if solutions have dependencies on the old behavior.
caveats: Legacy support is available but new flow is the default

features.name: Data transfer feature
features.description: Efficient SQL-based data migration feature that eliminates loopy entry-by-entry modifications when moving obsolete removed fields to new fields, reducing migration time from 2-24 hours to 2-5 minutes for 1 million entries.
caveats: only usable in upgrade scope to initialize new fields
cannot be used for SaaS solutions
target on-prem only
breaking change if events are not raised

features.name: Long-running methods optimization
features.description: Reduction of long-running methods during upgrade by 11 through optimization using the new data transfer feature, improving overall upgrade performance.

features.name: Cloud migration APIs
features.description: APIs for managing cloud migrations end-to-end, enabling automation of setup, company management, and cloud migration processes for bulk migrations of multiple companies.
caveats: examples available on BC Tech GitHub
